unresolved_intent.decision: Reject records with extra fields beyond first, last, and age.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The input contract says each record is an object with exactly those fields, so additional fields are treated as malformed rather than ignored.

unresolved_intent.decision: Reject JSON booleans for age even though bool is a subclass of int in Python.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The canonical package requires age to be an integer; JSON true/false are booleans, not integer ages.

unresolved_intent.decision: Emit compact JSON using separators without spaces between structural tokens.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The acceptance criteria fix only structure and values, so compact formatting is a valid formatting choice.

compilation_report.constraint_handling: pure Python standard library only; Python 3.8+ compatible; reads all input from stdin; prints exactly one line to stdout and exits 0; on malformed input prints ERROR for the whole batch
